rows.en:
(All right! I'm gonna enjoy Sheryl's concert
for all it's worth!)

(Still, it looks like Ranka isn't here yet...
Did she get lost or something?)
(Amazing...)

(Sheryl's overwhelming vocal power,
and a live performance that's every bit
as good...)

(Lately I've been treating her like a normal
classmate, so I forgot, but Sheryl really is
the "Galactic Fairy"...)
Hey, everybody! Are you feeling cultured?!
rows.notes: Sheryl's concert call 'bunka shiteru?' ('are you doing culture?'). No glossary rendering yet.

rows.en:
Time really flies, doesn't it?
It's already been a year since I came
to the Frontier.

I only meant to get a little taste of
high school life, but I never imagined
I'd end up staying this long.

But I truly, honestly think coming
to the Frontier was the right choice.

After all, I even got to make friends
with a cute girl like this...
rows.notes: kawaii ko: Ranka, about to be introduced.

rows.en: (Cute girl?)

Hehe, tonight I've brought along a special guest.
I don't hand out treats like this very often,
you know.

Now, you're up,
Ranka-chan!

I-I'm Ranka Lee!
It's nice to meet you all!
(R-Ranka?!)

Ranka-chan, you're way too nervous.
That's going overboard, even for you.
rows.notes: ikura nan demo: 'that's too much, whatever the excuse'.

rows.en:
But I'm going up on stage with you, Sheryl-san...
In front of this huge an audience, too...

It's all right.
You can do this...

After all,
you've got the seal of approval
from Sheryl Nome herself.

Okay...
I'll do my best!
Hehe, then let's go, Ranka-chan!
Yes! Sheryl-san!

Tonight, same as always, we're gonna charge
ahead at Macross speed!
rows.notes: 'Macross speed' as in the shipped tutorial line (u3245).

rows.en:
So... everybody, hold me tight!
To the ends of the galaxy!!
Listen to our song!!
rows.notes: Sheryl's catchphrase in the plural ('Listen to my song!!' in u1032).

rows.en:
(Sure, it wasn't a lie that she'd
invited Ranka too, but...)

(She invited her not as a guest,
but as one of the performers...)

(Haha, just like Sheryl said,
this is one amazing concert.)

(I should be proud to be friends
with divas as amazing as those two.)

(I hope we keep getting along from here on,
Sheryl, Ranka.)
rows.notes: kore kara mo yoroshiku tanomu na.

rows.en:
(Sheryl-san personally invited me to her concert
today... but is it really okay for me to be here?)
Oh, \p-chan. So you came.

Of course!
Thank you for inviting me to your concert
today, Sheryl-san.

And I'm sorry for barging in before the show.
When I showed my ticket, for some reason
they brought me all the way back here...

Oh, so Saotome-kun and the others got
brought to the dressing room too.
Now, now, calm down, Saotome-kun.
(Oh, so the other half was serious...)

Actually, \p-chan, I was going to ask you
and the others to do EX-Gear acrobatics
as part of the concert's performance.
(Hm? Did something happen with Ranka-chan?)

Huh? Come to think of it, didn't you invite
Ranka-chan to today's concert?

\p-chan...
Do you take me for the wicked stepmother
who bullies Cinderella?

Now then, the concert's about to start.
You and the others had better head
to your seats soon too, \p-chan.
Okay, I think I'll do that.

Of course!
Well, good luck out there, Sheryl-san.

(All right! I'm going to enjoy Sheryl-san's
concert for all it's worth!)

(Still, it looks like Ranka-chan isn't here
yet... Did she get lost or something?)
(Amazing...)

(Sheryl-san's overwhelming vocal power,
and a live performance that's every bit
as good...)

(Lately I've been treating her like a normal
classmate, so I forgot, but Sheryl-san really
is the "Galactic Fairy"...)
(R-Ranka-chan?!)

(Sure, it wasn't a lie that she'd
invited Ranka-chan too, but...)

(She invited her not as a guest,
but as one of the performers...)

(Haha, just like Sheryl-san said,
this is one amazing concert.)

(I should be proud to be friends
with divas as amazing as those two.)

(I hope we keep getting along from here on,
Sheryl-san, Ranka-chan.)
Wow... the sea on Island 3 really is beautiful.

Jeez, we're not here to play, you know.
Don't forget we came here to work,
\p.
rows.notes: Michel. x4: two occurrences in scd_fes_804 carry no name plate (PLAYER/none), right before Michel's wrap-up line; content only fits Michel.

rows.en: I know, I know, Michel.

Still, Mihoshi Academy and S.M.S. helping
film the stunts for a movie...
That's pretty incredible.

Just shows how much they're putting
into this movie.

For the Valkyrie dogfight scenes,
they're using real Valkyries, apparently.

Huh, really?
So what kind of Valkyrie are they using
for the shoot?

For this shoot, we'll be using the
"YF-25 Prophecy," the development
prototype of the VF-25.

To gather test data accurately, the Prophecy's
head carries multiple sensors that can record
and collect data from all directions, and...

(Uh-oh, Luca's started one of his
long explanations...)

In other words, it's no exaggeration to say
the Messiah was developed thanks to
the Prophecy, and...

Anyway, looks like they'll shoot it with
the YF-25 and then touch it up with CG.
But I'm not done explaining yet...
Okay then, let's get right to the shoot.

First up, we're filming a chase stunt in the
canyon. One of you plays that legendary
ace pilot, Roy Focker...

And the other plays the Anti-U.N. ace,
D.D. Ivanov.

I'm leaving the Focker role to you,
\p.
Got it.

And as for your opponent, D.D. Ivanov...
Let's see. Me or Alto,
you pick which one you want.
Do the stunt with Alto
Do the stunt with Michel
Then I guess I'll ask Alto to play Ivanov.

Heh, you're on.
Don't slack off just 'cause it's a stunt.
rows.notes: x4: Alto or Michel, whichever plays Ivanov.

rows.en: As if I would.

The AI operator will give you
instructions during the stunt.
